gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-bu: Thick-lined wobble up top, chalk-like open arcs below. Jelly Crazies seals its bowls almost shut while Noto Sans Buginese leaves every curve unjoined, and that push-pull is the best quality here.
